title: Vaporesso GTX Replacement Coils
description: These replacement Vaporesso GTX sub ohm mesh coils can be paired with many of Vaporesso’s bestselling vape kits and tanks, including the Vaporesso Target PM80, Target PM80 SE, Target PM30, Gen Nano and Xiron kits, thanks to their wide range of resistances. Their mesh coil build enhances the flavour of your favourite e-liquids while prolonging the life of the coil.
